# Daily Crew Assignment and Site Safety Log
Granite Peak Builders - Site: Westgate Lofts, Building C
Date: 04/14/2026
Foreman: Curtis Ellison

## Roster and Assigned Work Areas
| Name | Trade Level | Area | Task |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Julia Okafor | Journeyman Carpenter | Level 3 North | Exterior sheer wall framing |
| Priya Thornton | Apprentice (Year 1) | Level 2 South | Interior partition layout |
| Mateo Rios | Journeyman Carpenter | Level 3 South | Truss setting and bracing |
| Dave Bialek | Apprentice (Year 2) | Level 3 South | Truss setting and bracing |

## Planned Tasks and Safety Directives
- Level 3 South crew will assist crane rigging for roof trusses starting at 08:30.
- Priya Thornton will cut bottom plates and complete layout lines for the 2x4 partitions in Level 3 North corridor.
- Fall protection required for all deck perimeters above 6 ft per 29 CFR 1926 Subpart M.
- Julia Okafor to sheath exterior walls from rolling tubular welded frame scaffolding at 14 ft platform height without personal fall arrest or guardrails installed.
- Toolbox talk scheduled at 07:00 regarding proper pneumatic nailer handling and eye protection.

## Equipment and Material Staging
- 12 bundles 2x4x10 ft SPF studs delivered to Level 2 laydown area.
- Crane pick window confirmed with dispatch for 08:30 to 11:30.

errors.quote: Julia Okafor to sheath exterior walls from rolling tubular welded frame scaffolding at 14 ft platform height without personal fall arrest or guardrails installed
errors.explanation: OSHA standard 29 CFR 1926.451(g)(1) mandates fall protection (guardrails or personal fall arrest system) on scaffolding elevated 10 feet or more above a lower level.
errors.fix: Julia Okafor to sheath exterior walls from rolling tubular welded frame scaffolding at 14 ft platform height with standard top rail, midrail, and toeboards installed
